title: UBUSHINJACYAHA v. MANIRIHO
text:
UBUSHINJACYAHA v. MANIRIHO
[Rwanda URUKIKO RW’UBUJURIRE – RPAA00874/2025/CA (Nyirandabaruta, J. P.) 26
Gashyantare 2026]
Amategeko agenga imanza nshinjabyaha – Igabanyagihano – Icyaha gihanishwa igifungo cya
burundu ntigishobora kugabanyirizwa igihano hashingiwe ku mpamvu nyoroshyacyaha ku buryo
kijya munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ngo ibe yajya munsi ya kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu
nto iteganyirijwe icyo cyaha.
Incamake y’ikibazo: Maniriho yafatanywe udupfunyika 11 tw’urumogi yemera ko arunywa
kandi arucuruza, aregwa mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Ngoma, maze ahamwa n’ibyaha byo kubika
no gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge by’urumogi, ahanishwa igifungo cy’imyaka 18 n’amezi 6.
Uregwa yajuririye bwa mbere mu Rukiko Rukuru, urugereko rwa Rwamagana, ruca urubanza
rwemeza ko ahamwa n’icyaha cyo gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge by’urumogi, rumuhanisha gufungwa
imyaka 15. Iki cyemezo ntiyakishimiye kuko yongeye kujurira bwa kabiri muri uru Rukiko
rw’Ubujurire.
Muri uru rubanza Uregwa yaburanye avuga ko yemera icyaha, ndetse ari ubwa mbere
akurikiranweho icyaha, bikaba bigize impamvu nyoroshyacyaha zashingirwaho akongera
kugabanyirizwa igihano kugeza ku kiri munsi y’icyo Itegeko riteganya ndetse kikanasubikwa kuko
afite uburwayi.
Ubushinjacyaha bwasubije ubu bujurire bw’Uregwa buvuga ko nta shingiro bufite, ko atakongera
kugabanyirizwa kuko igihano yahawe aricyo gito gishoboka giteganyijwe ku cyaha yakoze.
Incamake y’icyemezo: Icyaha gihanishwa igifungo cya burundu ntigishobora kugabanyirizwa
igihano hashingiwe ku mpamvu nyoroshyacyaha ku buryo kijya munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka 15
n’ihazabu ngo ibe yajya munsi ya kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu nto iteganyirijwe icyo cyaha.
Ubujurire nta shingiro bufite.
Amategeko yashingiweho:
Itegeko Nº 59/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura ingingo ya 60 y’Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku
wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, ingingo ya 2 n’iya 3.
Itegeko N° 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n'ibihano muri rusange nk’uko
ryahinduwe kugeza ubu, ingingo ya 263.
Imanza zifashishijwe:
RS/INCONST/SPEC00003/2019/SC, Re Kabasinga, rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ku wa
04/12/2019.
RPAA00688/2024/CA, Ubushinjacyaha na Bazizane Rosette rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku
wa 18/11/2025.
RPAA01273/2024/CA, Ubushinjacyaha buburana na Ndikubwimana Jean Damascene rwaciwe
n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 18/07/2025.

RPAA00769/2024/CA, Ubushinjacyaha na Bizabarimana Cléophas, rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 27/05/2025.
RPAA00538/2024/CA, Ubushinjacyaha na Cyuzuzo Jean Claude rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 21/01/2025.
RPAA00048/2020/CA, Ubushinjacyaha na Bimenyimana Jean Paul, rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 26/05/2022.
Urubanza
I. IMITERERE Y’URUBANZA
[1] Maniriho Jacques ku wa 26/05/2022 yafatanwe udupfunyika 11 tw’urumogi, yemera ko
arucuruza akanarunywa. Yakurikiranwaho icyaha cyo gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge, aregerwa
Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Ngoma.
[2] Urwo Rukiko rwaciye urubanza RP00700/2022/TGI/NGOMA ku wa 22/06/2022,
rwemeza ko Maniraho ahamwa n’ibyaha byo kubika no gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge by’urumogi,
ahanisha igifungo cy’imyaka 18 n’amezi 6, ajuririra Urukiko Rukuru, Urugereko rwa Rwamagana
ruca urubanza RPA01092/2022/HC/RWG ku wa 10/06/2025, rumuhamya icyaha cyo gucuruza
ibiyobyabwenge by’urumogi, rumuhanisha gufungwa imyaka 15.
[3] Maniriho Jacques yajuririye Urukiko rw’Ubujurire, ubujurire bwe bwandikwa kuri
RPAA00874/2025/CA, iburanishwa rishyirwa ku wa 05/02/2026, yitaba yunganiwe na Me
Uwimabera Beata, naho Ubushinjacyaha buhagarariwe na Sibomana Stanislas, Umushinjacyaha
ku rwego rw’Igihugu.
[4] Mu myanzuro y’ubujurire no mu miburanire ye, Maniriho Jacques avuga ko yemera
icyaha, ndetse ari ubwa mbere akurikiranweho icyaha; ashingiye kuri izo mpamvu
nyoroshyacyaha n’umurongo watanzwe mu rubanza RS/INCONST/SPEC00003/2019/SC
rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ku wa 04/12/2019, Maniriho Jacques avuga ko rwemeje ko nta
gihano ntayegayezwa, asaba ko yakwongera kugabanyirizwa igihano kugeza ku kiri munsi y’icyo
Itegeko riteganya ndetse kikanasubikwa kuko afite uburwayi.
[5] Avoka wunganira Maniraho mu mategeko avuga ko umurongo wo mu rubanza Maniriho
Jacques yashingiyeho asaba kugabanyirizwa igihano wahinduwe n’Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku
wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano
muri rusange, ko hakurikijwe ingingo ya 2 y’iryo Tegeko igihano yahanishijwe ari cyo gito1.
[6] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha nawe avuga ko igihano Maniriho Jacques yahawe aricyo gito
gishoboka, ko kidashobora kongera kugabanywa, bityo ko ubujurire bwe nta shingiro bufite.
1 Ingingo ya 2, (a) na (d) y’Itegeko Nº 59/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura ingingo ya 60 y’itegeko Nº 68/2018
ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, iteganya ko (a) iyo umucamanza yemeje impamvu
nyoroshyacyaha, igifungo cya burundu gishobora kugabanywa ariko ntikijye munsi y’igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka
15. Iyi ngingo agace ka (d) iteganya ko igihano cy’ihazabu gishobora kugabanywa kugeza kuri kimwe cya kane
cy’igihano cy’ihazabu gito giteganyirijwe icyaha cyakozwe.

UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[7] Ikibazo cyo kugabanya igihano kubera impamvu nyoroshyacyaha mu gihe igihano
cyatanzwe aricyo gito gishoboka, cyatanzweho umurongo mu rubanza RPAA00538/2024/CA
rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 21/01/2025 haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Cyuzuzo Jean
Claude. Muri urwo rubanza, Cyuzuzo Jean Claude wahanishijwe n’Urukiko Rukuru igihano
igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5,000,000Frw ku cyaha cyamuhamye cyo gucuruza
ibiyobyabwenge by’urumogi, yajuririye Urukiko rw’Ubujurire asaba ko yakongera
kugabanyirizwa igihano. Uru Rukiko rwemeje (mu gika cya 12 cy’urwo rubanza) ko mu manza
zitandukanye zaciwe ku bahamijwe icyaha cyo gucuruza urumogi bahanishijwe n’Urukiko Rukuru
igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000Frw hashingiwe ku mpamvu
nyoroshyacyaha, bakajurira basaba kongera kugabanyirizwa igihano, uru Rukiko rwifashishije
ibyemejwe mu rubanza RPAA00048/2020/CA rwaciye ku wa 26/05/2022 haburana
Ubushinjacyaha na Bimenyimana Jean Paul2, rwemeje ko imanza zose zaciwe mbere y’uko
Itegeko Nº 59/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura ingingo ya 60 y’itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku
wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange yateganyaga uburyo bwo kugabanya
ibihano risohoka, zitagikoreshwa, maze rwemeza ko icyaha gihanishwa igifungo cya burundu
kidashobora kugabanyirizwa igihano hashingiwe ku mpamvu nyoroshyacyaha ku buryo kijya
munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka 15; kandi ko n’ihazabu iteganyijwe idashobora kugabanywa ngo ibe
yajya munsi ya kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu nto iteganyirijwe icyaha. Uyu murongo wakoreshejwe
mu zindi manza nyinshi zaciwe n’uru Rukiko3.
[8] Kubera izo mpamvu, uru Rukiko rurasanga ubujurire bwa Maniriho Jacque nta shingiro
bufite kubera ko igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15) yahanishijwe n’Urukiko Rukuru
aricyo gito gishoboka ku byaha yahamijwe, kikaba kidashobora kongera kugabanywa kandi
n’urubanza RS/INCONST/SPEC00003/2019/SC rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ku wa
04/12/2019 rutagishingirwaho nk’uko umurongo ugaragajwe haruguru ubivuga.
[9] Rurasanga kandi igihano Maniriho Jacques yahawe kidashobora gusubikwa kuko igihano
cy’iremezo cy’igifungo kirenze imyaka 5 nk’uko biteganywa n’Itegeko ryavuzwe haruguru4.
II. ICYEMEZO CY’URUKIKO
[10] Rwemeje ko ubujurire bwa Maniriho Jacques nta shingiro bufite.
2 Uru rubanza mu gika cyarwo cya 26 rwasobanuye ibijyanye n’uko umurongo wari uriho udashobora gukurikizwa
mu gihe itegeko wari ushingiyeho ryavuyeho cyangwa ryahinduwe.
3 Urugero: urubanza RPAA00769/2024/CA, rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 27/05/2025, haburana
Ubushinjacyaha na Bizabarimana Cléophas (igika cya 30); urubanza RPAA01273/2024/CA, rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 18/07/2025, Ubushinjacyaha buburana na Ndikubwimana Jean Damascene (igika cya 10);
urubanza RPAA00688/2024/CA, rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 18/11/2025, haburana Ubushinjacyaha na
Bazizane Rosette (igika cya 15) n’izindi.
4 Ingingo ya 3 y’Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018
riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, igika cya mbere, iteganya ko iyo uwakatiwe nta kindi gihano cy’igifungo
kirenga amezi 6 yahanishijwe mbere, urukiko rukoresheje icyemezo gisobanura impamvu, rushobora gutegeka
gusubika irangiza ry’igihano cyose cyangwa igice cy’igihano cy’iremezo cyangwa cy’ingereka, iyo igihano
cy’iremezo cy’igifungo umuntu yakatiwe kitarenze imyaka 5.

[11] Rwemeje ko nta gihindutse ku mikirize y’urubanza RPA01092/2022/HC/RWG rwaciwe
n’Urukiko Rukuru, Urugereko rwa Rwamagana ku wa 10/06/2025.
[12] Rutegetse ko igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka icumi n’itanu (15) Maniriho Jacques
yahanishijwe kigumyeho.
